This skill requires the Launcher Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  An advanced mechanical course covering all areas of Launcher weapon operations in regards to durability. This skill teaches how to keep those Launcher modules running smooth with custom parts, mods, and in some cases, fabrication.

Basic Miner Operation will provide you with all the basic knowledge about the operation, maintenance and upkeep of all active Mining modules. The level of the Mining module is directly linked to the level of operation required to use it.

This skill requires the Miner Basic Operation skill trained to level 3.  Learning advanced excavation techniques are just the beginning of a long lasting career as a miner. This skill will unlock a number of other skills that specialize in mining and collecting raw ore.

This skill requires the Miner Basic Operation skill trained to level 2.  This specialized skill will boost the effective range of all Mining modules installed, allowing you to collect resources from longer distances. Each additional level of this skill will further improve the range, with a maximum training level of 10.

This skill requires the Miner Basic Operation skill trained to level 1.  Miner Energy Optimization will reduce the energy requirements per cycle of each Mining module installed. This can add up to a huge savings in energy during extended mining sessions. Every skill level of training will further reduce the required energy to a max level of 10.

This skill requires the Miner Advanced Systems skill trained to level 3.  The Miner cycle time for every installed Mining module will be decreased with each training level of this skill. By reducing the cycle time, the rate of fire will increase and allow you to collect more resources over a short period of time.

This skill requires the Miner Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  This skill will provide excavators with specialized training that centers around the focal damage output for each installed Mining beam. 10 levels of focused training will provide you with an advanced understanding of mining beam focal damage.

This skill requires the Miner Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  An advanced mechanical course covering all areas of Mining modules operations in regards to durability. This skill teaches how to keep those Mining modules running smooth with custom parts, mods, and in some cases, fabrication.

This skill will provide specialized training for the ships gyroscopic control system. This will affect how the ship handles by tweaking how fast the ship can turn. By shifting mass, and fine tuning the vector thrust systems, each level of this skill will improve the turning speed.

This skill requires the Ship Gyroscopic Control skill trained to level 1.  Training up the Thrust Systems of a ship will help to improve the ship's top speed. This skill will not affect the energy requirements of the engines, but by adjusting the fuel mixture, you can greatly improve the performance of the engines.

This skill requires the Ship Thruster Systems skill trained to level 1.  Learning this skill will improve the power of your afterburner systems. Afterburners are a great way to cover long distances, or even avoid incoming attacks from raiders. You can train this skill to a max level of 10, with each level giving you an additional boost.

The mass of your ship affects how fast it can turn, and how effective the engines and afterburner systems are. By training this skill, you will learn how to reduced the overall mass of your ship, thus increasing its performance. Each level reduce your mass by 2.5%, for a maximum of a 25% reduction.

This skill requires the Ship Thruster Systems skill trained to level 3.  Learning to modify your engine systems can be quite handy. This skill will teach you to reduce the energy burn that your engines have on your ship's energy core. Each level of this skill reduce the energy drain of your engines by 5%.

Scanner systems training will provide you with an advanced understanding of the integrated ship scanner ping. Each ship has a scanner system that will allow the pilot to target objects in space. With each level, the speed of the scan ping will increase.

This skill requires the Passive Scanner Systems skill trained to level 2.  The Scanner Range skill will help you better understand the mechanics of the integrated ship scanner. With each level of this skill, every ship you pilot will have an improved range to their ship's scanner.

This skill requires the Passive Scanner Systems skill trained to level 4.  This is a very important skill. It will increase the number of targets your scanner can hold. Each level of this skill will provide one additional target slot to the targeting system.

This skill requires the Ship Mass Engineering skill trained to level 1.  Training the Cargo stacker skill will give the pilot the ability to modify the internal structures of the cargo bay, thus providing an increase to the available storage size. Each level trained of this skill will increase the max cargo space for the piloted ship.

The Shield Systems skill will teach you how to tweak and modify the internal shield system computer to overdrive the shield generator. This will provide you with a bonus to your overall max capacity of the ship's shield. Each level will improve this bonus (10 levels max).

This skill requires the Ship Shield Systems skill trained to level 2.  The Shield Regeneration skill will give you a greater understanding on how the ship's energy core regenerates the shields of the ship. Each level of training will increase the speed at which the shield regenerates. You can train this skill to a maximum of 10 levels.

The Armor Management skill will teach you how to properly modify the ship's core armor to provide additional protection from beams, lasers, missiles, and projectiles. Each level of this skill will boost the max armor value of the ship. This skill can be trained for a max of 10 levels.

This skill requires the Ship Armor Management skill trained to level 2.  All ships have a small number of nano-drones that keep many of the basic ship functions working properly. This skill will provide you with the ability to re-program these nano-drones to repair the ship's outer armor. Each level of this skill will increase the automated armor repair rate.

This is a basic skill that will give you the ability to tweak the energy core of the ship, allowing for an increase in the max power the core can supply. Each level of this skill will boost the ship's overall energy capacity. You can train this skill to a maximum of 10 levels.

This skill requires the Ship Energy Systems skill trained to level 2.  This is a basic skill that will give you the ability to tweak the energy core of the ship, allowing for an increase in how fast the core can supply power. Each level of this skill will boost the ship's overall energy regeneration. You can train this skill to a maximum of 10 levels.

This skill requires the Ship Armor Management skill trained to level 5.  This skill will teach you how to modify your ship's armor systems to provide additional Impact resistance to your ship. Each level of this skill will increase the overall resistance of the ship by 5%. Keep in mind, if you ship has no resistance to increase, this skill will not provide any benefit.

This skill requires the Ship Armor Management skill trained to level 5.  This skill will teach you how to modify your ship's armor systems to provide additional Energy resistance to your ship. Each level of this skill will increase the overall resistance of the ship by 5%. Keep in mind, if you ship has no resistance to increase, this skill will not provide any benefit.

This skill requires the Ship Armor Management skill trained to level 5. This skill will teach you how to modify your ship's armor systems to provide additional Explosive resistance to your ship. Each level of this skill will increase the overall resistance of the ship by 5%. Keep in mind, if you ship has no resistance to increase, this skill will not provide any benefit.

Basic Salvager Operation will provide you with all the basic knowledge about the operation, maintenance and upkeep of all active Salvaging modules. The level of the Salvage module is directly linked to the level of operation required to use it.

This skill requires the Salvager Basic Operation skill trained to level 3.  Learning advanced salvaging techniques can be extremely helpful when attempting to recover junk, scrap, salvage, and derelicts. This skill will unlock a number of other skills that specialize in salvaging and collecting debris.

This skill requires the Salvager Basic Operation skill trained to level 2.  This specialized skill will boost the effective range of all Salvager modules installed, allowing you to collect debris from longer distances. Each additional level of this skill will further improve the range, with a maximum training level of 10.

This skill requires the Salvager Basic Operation skill trained to level 1.  Salvager Energy Optimization will reduce the energy requirements per cycle of each Salvager module installed. This can add up to a huge savings in energy during extended salvage sessions. Every skill level of training will further reduce the required energy to a max level of 10.

This skill requires the Salvager Advanced Systems skill trained to level 3.  The Salvager cycle time for every installed Salvager module will be decreased with each training level of this skill. By reducing the cycle time, the rate of fire will increase and allow you to collect more debris over a short period of time.

This skill requires the Salvager Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  This skill will provide Salvagers with specialized training that centers around the focal damage output for each installed Salvager beam. 10 levels of focused training will provide you with an advanced understanding of Salvager beam focal damage.

This skill requires the Salvager Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  An advanced mechanical course covering all areas of Salvager modules operations in regards to durability. This skill teaches how to keep those Salvager modules running smooth with custom parts, mods, and in some cases, fabrication.

Training this skill will provide you with a general bonus to your life support systems. By tweaking the internal regulator, the maximum bonus provided by the life support systems will increase with each level trained. 10 levels max.

This skill requires the Ship LS System Maintenance skill trained to level 1.  This skill will provide you with the ability to modify the food synth, thus reducing the environmental effects that can negatively impact your life support systems. Each level of this skill will improve the overall functionality of the LS food system.

This skill requires the Ship LS System Maintenance skill trained to level 2.  Training the Advanced Water systems skill will boost the overall effectiveness of the water filtration system of your ship's Life Support computer. With each level of this skill, your water filtration will function more efficiently, giving you more time undocked.

This skill requires the Ship LS System Maintenance skill trained to level 3.  This skill will teach you how to manipulate the thermal regulator of your life support system. This will help you ship maintain a somewhat comfortable temperature inside the cockpit. This skill can be trained to a max level of 10.

This skill requires the Ship LS System Maintenance skill trained to level 4 . It is very important that your life support system is processing your waste efficiently. This skill will slowly improve your ship's ability to process waste into energy that your ship can use and provide you with more fly time in between those bathroom breaks.

Basic Torpedo Operation will provide you with all the basic knowledge about the operation, maintenance and upkeep of all active Torpedo modules. The level of the Torpedo module is directly linked to the level of operation required to use it.

This skill requires the Torpedo Basic Operation skill trained to level 3.  Advanced Torpedo systems not only provides pilots with additional training about the use of Torpedo weapons, but also unlocks the use of special Torpedo weapons. Each level of training provides a small bonus to all attributes dealing with Torpedo weapons.

This skill requires the Torpedo Basic Operation skill trained to level 2.  This specialized skill will boost the effective range of all Torpedo Weapons installed. Each additional level of this skill will further improve the range, with a maximum training level of 10.

This skill requires the Torpedo Basic Operation skill trained to level 1.  Torpedo Energy Optimization will reduce the energy requirements per cycle of each Torpedo weapon installed. This can add up to a huge savings in energy during a simple 3 minute skirmish. Every skill level of training will further reduce the required energy to a max level of 10.

This skill requires the Torpedo Advanced Systems skill trained to level 3.  The Torpedo Launcher cycle time for every installed Torpedo Weapon will be decreased with each training level of this skill. By reducing the cycle time, the rate of fire will increase and allow you to deliver additional rounds during those critical moments.

This skill requires the Torpedo Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  This skill will provide pilots with specialized training that centers around maximum damage output for each installed Torpedo Launcher weapon. 10 levels of focused training will provide any student with an advanced understanding of (AFDS) protocols. (Augmented Firepower Delivery Systems)

This skill requires the Torpedo Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  An advanced mechanical course covering all areas of Torpedo Launcher weapon operations in regards to durability. This skill teaches how to keep those Torpedo Launcher modules running smooth with custom parts, mods, and in some cases, fabrication.

Training this skill will provide you with the organizational abilities to manage multiple mission contracts at the same time. After each level of training, your contract license is upgraded and an additional contract slot becomes available.

This skill requires the Max Mission Contracts skill trained to level 1.  The ability to negotiate for the best prices when dealing with mission contractors can be a profitable skill to have. Each level of training will increase the payments for these contracts.

This skill requires the Max Mission Contracts skill trained to level 2.  This skill will increase the faction bonus you receive for completing a mission contract. Each level of training will boost the total amount of faction points you can receive, up to 10 levels max.

Basic Tractor Operation will provide you with all the basic knowledge about the operation, maintenance and upkeep of all active Tractor modules. The level of the Tractor module is directly linked to the level of operation required to use it.

This skill requires the Tractor Basic Operation skill trained to level 3.  Advanced Tractor systems not only provides pilots with additional training about the use of Tractor modules, but also unlocks the use of special Tractor modules. Each level of training provides a small bonus to all attributes dealing with Tractor modules.

This skill requires the Tractor Basic Operation skill trained to level 2.  This specialized skill will boost the effective range of all Tractor Weapons installed. Each additional level of this skill will further improve the range, with a maximum training level of 10.

This skill requires the Tractor Basic Operation skill trained to level 1.  Tractor Energy Optimization will reduce the energy requirements per cycle of each Tractor weapon installed. This can add up to a huge savings in energy during a simple 3 minute skirmish. Every skill level of training will further reduce the required energy to a max level of 10.

This skill requires the Tractor Advanced Systems skill trained to level 3.  The Tractor Beam cycle time for every installed Tractor Beam will be decreased with each training level of this skill. By reducing the cycle time, the rate of fire will increase and allow you to deliver additional rounds during those critical moments.

This skill requires the Tractor Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  This skill will provide pilots with specialized training that centers around maximum damage output for each installed Tractor Beam weapon. 10 levels of focused training will provide any student with an advanced understanding of (AFDS) protocols. (Augmented Firepower Delivery Systems)

This skill requires the Tractor Advanced Systems skill trained to level 4.  An advanced mechanical course covering all areas of Tractor Beam operations in regards to durability. This skill teaches how to keep those Tractor Beam modules running smooth with custom parts, mods, and in some cases, fabrication.

This skill requires the Ship Advanced Targeting Systems skill trained to level 3.  ECM operation training will provide you the ability to install, and operate active ECM modules. These modules will provide your ship with electronic counter measures. This skill is required to train the more advanced ECM skills.

This skill requires the ECM Module Operation skill trained to level 2.  The ECM power represents how strong the module's signal is. This skill will increase the power of all ECM modules installed on the ship. This skill is also required to progress in the training of other ECM skills.

This skill requires the ECM Power System skill trained to level 4.  Due to the nature of ECM, the energy required to power the electro magnetic cores of the ECM modules is very taxing on the ships energy system. By training this skill, you will reduced the required energy to cycle each ECM modules installed.

This skill requires the ECM Energy Management skill trained to level 3.  The focal range of the ECM module can by fined tuned to provide a longer range of effectiveness. Each level of this skill will help to improve the overall distance in which the ECM module can be effective.

This skill requires the ECM Module Operation skill trained to level 5.  The ability to resist electronic attacks from would be bandits is a very valuable skill to have. Each level of training will increase your ability to avoid incoming electronic attacks by tweaking your ship's computer systems and blocking exploits.

This skill requires the ECM Module Operation skill trained to level 6.  This skill will provide the pilot with the training required to operate a cloak field device. Cloak fields can produce an electronic camouflage that can hide the ship, not only from visible view, but also to a range of electronic sensors. Each level of training will increase the level of module that can be used.

This skill requires the Cloak Field Operation skill trained to level 1.  Cloak power represents how strong the module's field is. This skill will increase the the power of all cloak modules installed on the ship. This skill is also required to progress in the training of other cloaking skills.

This skill requires the Cloak Field Operation skill trained to level 2.  Due to the nature of cloaking, the energy required to power the field generator of the cloak module is very taxing on the ships energy system. By training this skill, you will reduced the required energy of each cloak module installed.

This skill requires the Cloak Field Operation skill trained to level 3. The effective range of the cloak field module can by fined tuned to provide a larger radius of effectiveness. Each level of this skill will help to improve the overall distance in which the cloak field module can render the ship invisible.

This skill requires the Cloak Field Operation skill trained to level 4.  The cloak sensors are an important skill to train if you want to detect cloaked ships in the area. Cloaking is often viewed as something only thieves and hijackers use to surprise unsuspecting victims. The cloak sensor skill will increase your chance of detecting a cloaked ship nearby.

This skill will train you on how to properly command a fleet of starships. Each level of this skill will allow for one additional fleet member to join your fleet. You can train this skill to a maximum of 10 levels.

This skill requires the Fleet Commander skill trained to level 2.  Training this skill will provide you and your fleet with additional combat training. This will help to improve the Merc's ability to lock targets and make the most of their combat capabilities. 10 level maximum.

This skill requires the Fleet Commander skill trained to level 2.  The Merc Defensive training will teach you how to better command your fleet, and provide a slight defensive bonus to any damage they may sustain. There are 10 levels of this skill available.

This skill requires the Fleet Commander skill trained to level 1.  The Fleet Navigation skill will boost the overall top speeds of all of the mercs in your fleet. This skill will also reduce the penalty suffered when locking a formation of Mercs. There are only 10 levels of this skill.

This skill will provide you with the ability to pilot Escort class ships. Escorts are small, fast, but useful ships with just a few modules slots. Training additional levels of this skill may be required before piloting higher level ships of this class.

This skill requires the Escort Ship Operation skill trained to level 1.  This skill will provide you with the ability to pilot Utility class ships. Utility class ships are mainly used for excavation and construction, but they make decent combat ships as well. Training additional levels of this skill may be required before piloting higher level ships of this class.

This skill requires the Utility Ship Operation skill trained to level 1.  This skill will provide you with the ability to pilot Frigate class ships. Frigates are extremely versatile, with a variety of configurations that allow for a number of roles. Training additional levels of this skill may be required before piloting higher level ships.

This skill requires the Frigate Ship Operation skill trained to level 1.  This skill will provide you with the ability to pilot Cruiser class ships. Training additional levels of this skill may be required before piloting higher level ships.

This skill requires the Cruiser Ship Operation skill trained to level 1.  This skill will provide you with the ability to pilot Carrier class ships. Training additional levels of this skill may be required before piloting higher level ships.

This skill requires the Carrier Ship Operation skill trained to level 2.  This skill will provide you with the ability to pilot Destroyer class ships. Training additional levels of this skill may be required before piloting higher level ships.

This skill requires the Destroyer Ship Operation skill trained to level 3.  This skill will provide you with the ability to pilot Battlecruiser class ships. Training additional levels of this skill may be required before piloting higher level ships.

This skill requires the Battlecruiser Ship Operation skill trained to level 4.  This skill will provide you with the ability to pilot Dreadnought class ships. Training additional levels of this skill may be required before piloting higher level ships.

This service skill will augment the available space provided by any station refinery. Since the refinery can only hold so much at a time, you may be required to refine your raw ore in batches. Each level of this skill will increase the max capacity of the refinery cargo bay.

This skill requires the Refinery Warehouse Management skill trained to level 3.  When looking to reduce the overall cost of refinery operations, this skill will teach you how to better negotiate with the local foreman, thus reducing the overall cost of each cycle. Each level of this skill will further reduce the costs associated with it's operation.

This skill requires the Refinery Warehouse Management skill trained to level 2.  This skill will teach you how to best operate the refinery machine. Knowing how the refinery works, will give you the ability to optimize various aspects of the operation. Each level of this skill will increase the items processed per cycle by 5.

Training levels of the Market Auditor skill will improve your ability to pay attention to the financial details of the markets, finding savings in tax loopholes and the like. Each level of this skill will help to reduce the overall tax rate on buying goods at the stations.
This skill requires the Market Auditor skill trained to level 1.  This skill will provide you with an intimate knowledge of local vendors, allowing you to negotiate better prices for your goods.
This skill allows you to negotiate better terms with new Mercs, allowing you to pay them less each day.
This skill requires the Merc Negotiations skill trained to level 1.  This skill allows you to find mercs that don't go out of their way to advertise their services.
This skill teaches you the ins and outs of the Fabricator system, allowing you to boost production speeds.
This skill requires the Fabrication Engineer skill trained to level 1.  This skill teaches you how to adjust the Fabricator to be more efficient, reducing waste and improving production costs.
By learning the jargon used by the station mechanics you can better describe issues with the Armor systems, allowing them to work faster which means they charge less for repair time.

This skill requires the Armor Mechanic skill trained to level 1.  By learning the jargon used by the station mechanics you can better describe issues with the Module systems, allowing them to work faster which means they charge less for repair time.
By learning how to stack cargo more efficiently you can store more supplies in the same amount of storage space.

This skill requires the Storage Manager skill trained to level 1.  This skill allows you to make special arrangements with the station storage master to get a reduced storage rate when you lease additional space.
Using this program, you can apply for special grants that allow you to train skills at the University somewhat cheaper.
This skill requires the University Discount skill trained to level 1.  By learning how to use the latest teaching software the amount of time required to learn a new skill is reduced.

This skill will provide you with the basic knowledge on how to operate construction equipment needed to build and upgrade structures in space. Each level of this skill will allow for an additional structure level to be constructed.

This skill requires the Structure Build Operation skill trained to level 1. This service skill will augment the available space provided by any structure cargo bay you currently own. Since the structure can only hold so much at a time, you may need more space to storage the materials required for the next upgrade. Each level of this skill will increase the max capacity of the structure cargo bay.

This skill requires the Structure Build Operation skill trained to level 2. When looking to reduce the overall cost of structure operations and upgrades, this skill will teach you how to better negotiate with the local foreman, thus reducing the overhead. Each level of this skill will further reduce the costs associated with structure operation.

This skill requires the Structure Build Operation skill trained to level 3. This skill will teach you how to best operate when upgrading and building structures. Knowing how it all works will give you the ability to optimize various aspects of the operation. Each level of this skill will reduce the required materials for each structure you own.

This skill requires the Structure Build Operation skill trained to level 5. This skill will help you learn to maximize your efforts, thus reducing the time it takes to upgrade or build a new structure. Each level of this skill will improve the overall speed of all the current, and future structures you own.
This skill will provide you with the basic knowledge on how to operate drones. Each level of this skill will allow for additional drone training in various specialized areas.

This skill requires the Drone Operation skill trained to level 2.  This drone skill will allow you to control an additional drone without the need for any modules or upgrade. A maximum of 10 levels of this skill can be trained.
This skill requires the Drone Operation skill trained to level 3.  This skill will increase the damage that a drone can deliver.

This skill requires the Drone Operation skill trained to level 3.  This skill will increase the power of a drone's mining laser. This will result in a high yield of ore being transferred into the drone's cargo bay.
This skill requires the Drone Operation skill trained to level 3.  This skill will increase the repair ability of repair drones.

This skill requires the Drone Combat Weapons skill trained to level 1.  This skill will increase the defensive capabilities of the drone, causing it to zap any incoming threats to the parent ship or target.

This skill requires the Drone Command Systems skill trained to level 5.  This skill will increase the range that a drone can fly before losing a clean signal. Once a signal is lost, the drone cannot perform very well, this skill will help with that.

This skill requires the Drone Command Systems skill trained to level 5.  This skill will increase the max capacity of the drone's energy core. Drones will use the ship's energy to recharge when docked.
This skill requires the Drone Operation skill trained to level 5.  This skill will help you to learn how to modify you drones so that they can sustain additional damage before exploding.

This skill requires the Drone Operation skill trained to level 5.  This skill will teach you to increase the size of your drone's cargo bay. This will allow the drone to mine ore for a bit longer before having to return to the ship.

This skill requires the Drone Operation skill trained to level 5.  This skill will walk you through the basics of drone propulsion systems. By tweaking the thruster, you can achieve a higher force thrust from a basic drone thruster.

Commercial and corporate docks are used to store large quantities of goods and materials. These facilities provide the warehouse space required when manufacturing products for the Astrox universe.

Energy structures are one of the most important structures available. It can produce a field of energy by converting the tiny particles of frozen water and carbon into electricity. Power is then transfered to all structures within a 1500 meter radius.

Energy structures are one of the most important structures available. It can produce a field of energy by converting the tiny particles of frozen water and carbon into electricity. This power is then transferred to all structures within a 1500 meter radius.

Each farming center can produce enough food for an entire habitation module, and then some. For the population of a sector to thrive, it is important that they can grow enough food to sustain steady growth. Parking near a farm provides no effect.

The Small Laser Platform is a defensive structure capable of holding 2 laser modules. These structures are specifically designed to deliver automated defensive firepower to raiders and enemies of the operator that owns it.

The Small Missile Platform is a defensive structure capable of holding 2 missile launcher modules. These structures are specifically designed to deliver automated defensive firepower to raiders and enemies of the operator that owns it. Must be stocked with missiles to operate.

The Gun platform is a defensive structure capable of holding up to 12 module slots. These structures are specifically designed to deliver automated defensive firepower to raiders and enemies of the faction that owns it.

Habatation structures are used solely as homes for the residents of Astrox. There is little to no commerce, or any other function of these structures other than providing a place to live and sleep, for the working population of this sector.
Machine

Medical structures not only provide the population of the sector with doctors and medicine, but also will slowly recharge the lifesupport systems of any ship at no cost. This facility will boost the population grow rate, happiness, and lifespan.
Office structures can provide a sector with an economic boost. They are places of management and organization, and usually revolve around profit. There is no area effect on this structure.

The construction platform is used as a base foundation for all structures in the Astrox universe. Once the Construction Platform has been assembled, materials can be delivered to the platform for upgrades and construction.
Raider hideouts are dangerous structures to hang around. Raiders don't like us civilians, and have no problem ganging up on you.

The Recon Center is used mainly to conduct space traffic, and to monitor the sector warp gates. By doing so, any conflicts can immediately be reported to the Astrox Security Patrol (ASP). This facility does not provide any active bonuses, but often contains valuable passkeys for sale.
The silo is used as an in between point for miners and transports alike. The storage provided by the silo will allow mercs to deposit the ore they mine automatically.

The silo is used as an in between point for miners and transports alike. The storage provided by the silo will allow mercs to deposit the ore they mine automatically. The expanded silo has additional cargo bay space.

The silo is used as an in between point for miners and transports alike. The storage provided by the silo will allow mercs to deposit the ore they mine automatically. The Advanced Mining Silo has many large storage tanks, plenty of room for all that unrefined ore.

The Station Construction Platform will transform the Energy Generator structure into a new station for the sector. Once a station has been constructed, it will no longer function as a structure, and can be used like a normal station with access to all the various station services available. The newly created station cannot be downgraded, and any existing power supply lines from the Energy Generator will be removed, and adjacent structure will no longer be powered when the station has been completed.
Storage structures are required to store large numbers of resources for giant construction projects.

The small Warpgate Generator can be deployed in order to stabilise nearby wormhole energy. Once a gate is deployed within range of the wormhole, the warpgate will provide the required energy to stabalize the entrance to the wormhole.
